title: Explain a Changed Journey
instructions: Record the model, then describe your own journey using different places and times.
prompt: Describe a planned train journey and one change. Explain where you are going, what you usually do before traveling, what is happening now, and how you are changing the arrangement. Give a reason for your decision. Speak for about 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I usually check the timetable before I travel. Today I am waiting at the main terminal with a small suitcase. My destination is a town by the sea, but there is a delay. I am checking the new departure time and listening to the announcement. My ticket is valid on a direct service, so I do not need a transfer. I am asking the conductor about a seat reservation near the luggage space. My friend is meeting me at the station this afternoon. I am sending her the new arrival time so that she does not have to wait too long. Before I board, I will check the platform display once more.
